pages.title: India–US trade deal — dairy and agriculture hurdles

facts.text: Deadline: 9 July 2025 — US to reimpose reciprocal tariffs (back to 2 April levels) if no deal
facts.head: News

facts.text: Sticking points: agriculture and dairy (small producers; hormones in US milk)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Plan: a "mini trade deal" then first tranche of Bilateral Trade Agreement (BTA) by Fall 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Earlier: US withdrew India's GSP status in 2019
facts.head: News

facts.text: India "the only country" in such elaborate talks with the US
facts.head: News

facts.text: Alternatives to Hormuz route: Chabahar, INSTC
facts.head: News

pages.title: South Asia — least economically integrated region

facts.text: Item: Intra-regional trade (SAFTA); Detail: only 5–7% of total trade — vs EU 45%, NAFTA 25%, ASEAN 22%
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: SAARC trade; Detail: $23 billion vs potential $67 billion (UNESCAP: $172 billion in 2020)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: Intra-SAARC trade cost; Detail: 114% of goods value; with US 109%; ASEAN 76%
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: India–Pakistan trade; Detail: $2.41 bn (2018) → $1.2 bn (2024); Pakistan's exports to India $547.5 m (2019) → $480,000 (2024)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: Trade-to-GDP; Detail: 47.3% (2022) → 42.94% (2024)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: Unexploited potential; Detail: over 86%; Bangladesh highest at 93%
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Triggers in 2025: US reciprocal tariffs; Pahalgam terror attack
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Suggested: revive SAARC summits; BBIN Motor Vehicle Agreement
facts.head: Data

pages.title: SEBI governance reforms for Market Infrastructure Institutions

facts.text: Consultation paper: 24 June 2025; comments till 15 July 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: MIIs: stock exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories
facts.head: News

facts.text: Proposal: at least two Executive Directors (EDs) per MII, reporting to the MD
facts.head: News

facts.text: Vertical: Critical Operations; Head: ED (mandatory)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Vertical: Regulatory, Compliance, Risk Management, Investor Grievances; Head: ED (mandatory)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Vertical: Commercial Interests & Business Development; Head: ED at MII's discretion
facts.head: News

facts.text: Board: EDs of first two verticals on the Governing Board, status like MD; appointment needs SEBI approval
facts.head: News

facts.text: Reports: quarterly to Board and SEBI
facts.head: News

facts.text: Directorships: MDs may hold non-executive posts in unlisted govt companies or not-for-profits; ⚠ EDs none except MII subsidiaries
facts.head: News

facts.text: Launched: 2020; started with 3 sectors, now 14; disbursals in 12 sectors (as of March 2025)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Review by: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Incentives disbursed; Value: ₹21,534 crore (headline ₹21,535 crore)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Investment; Value: ₹1.76 lakh crore
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Production/sales; Value: ₹16.5 lakh crore
facts.head: News

facts.text: Pharma: sales ₹2.66 lakh crore, exports ₹1.70 lakh crore (3 years); FY25 exports ₹0.67 lakh crore (~27% of pharma exports); 40% of ₹37,306 crore investment in R&D; domestic value addition 83.7%
